title: WORKSHEET 9
subject: Simple Past and Past Continuous
subjectVi: Ngữ pháp bài 9: Simple Past and Past Continuous

sections.instruction: Fill in the blanks with a correct form of PAST CONTINUOUS. (Example: It was very cold. The sun was not shining. (not / shine))

questions.prompt: It wasn't a stormy night. The wind [gap] (not / blow).
He wasn't sleeping. He [gap] (look) at the ceiling.
They were having a rest. They [gap] (not / work).
They were very happy. They [gap] (enjoy) the party.
He was at home. He [gap] (watch) a movie on TV.
He was getting worse. He [gap] (not / recover).
We [gap] (travel) in the north of Turkey when we were on holiday.
She [gap] (drive) so fast when the accident happened.
questions.explanation: interrupted action: past continuous + past simple
